name: silvie-earths-tune-enter-reveals-until-deep-tera-animal-rest-to-bottom
notes: Silvie, Earth's Tune (ZR8tnLruR6), leveled up from Silvie, With the Pack: the first tera Animal/Beast ally (Gaia's Songbird) is the 4th card; it goes to hand and the three revealed cards before it go to the bottom (a Fluffy Shopkeep below them is the level-up's own draw; a marker is the new top). Pre-fix only one of them moved.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a tera element Animal or Beast ally card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your deck in a random order.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Same defect as Gaia's Songbird: the generated enterAbilities["ZR8tnLruR6:0"] put the revealed-but-not-taken cards on the bottom with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myDeck") -- Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so only ONE of them reached the bottom and the rest stayed on top. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (shared with Gaia's Songbird) with MZMoveTopOfZone().
